messages:
incident-bot: Pager triggered: inference-error-rate-high in az1a (rule: inference.p95_latency > 750ms for 3m). Incident ID: INC-2026-33245 :rotating_light:

sarah (oncall): seeing rising 5xxs and token generation timeouts. p95 -> 1.2s, error rate ~12% over last 5m. ENI rx_drop metric spiking on az1a hosts.

michael (infra): confirming host network jitter on az1a. CloudNet reports transient enic retries and AWS ENI TX errors. No full instance terminations yet.

raj (runtime): kv-cache misses jumped during reroutes — regeneration is causing additional token latency. Looks like when requests land on fallback nodes we get cold KV cache for some model shards.

sarah (oncall): initial mitigation idea: steer non-critical traffic away from az1a to fallback region (eu-west-1) and enable prefix-level caching on the runtime to avoid immediate KV regen. Will coordinate traffic-shift and cache toggle.

michael (infra): starting controlled traffic shift. Command I ran:```\n# shift 10% of inference traffic off az1a to eu-west-1\nredwood-traffic shift --from az1a --to eu-west-1 --pct 10 --reason "egress jitter in az1a"\n```

sarah (oncall): dropping into routing config now. watch p95 and 5xx. Can someone confirm NLB healthy targets in eu-west-1?

cloud-support-bot: AWS advisory: "We are investigating elevated packet drops in a subset of AZ1a ENIs; no fabric-wide outages reported." (case# 12345)

michael (infra): eu-west-1 targets green, can accept burst. Increasing the shift to 40% to relieve az1a. Doing canary for 5m before wider shift.

raj (runtime): enabling prefix caching:```\nruntime-config set --prefix-cache on --ttl 30m --paths "/v1/generate,/v1/chat"\n```

sarah (oncall): observed immediate drop in kv-cache regen rate after prefix cache toggle. p95 for routed requests dropped ~250ms. 5xx rate down to ~7%.

product-ops: any customer-visible impact? need messaging.

sarah (oncall): customer impact: subset of requests originating in us-east with AZ affinity to az1a saw increased latency and errors. We estimate ~3% of total requests affected at peak; top affected customers: internal test cluster + two small enterprise tenants (IDs redacted).

michael (infra): raising compute in other zones: provisioning 6 additional g5 nodes in az1b and eu-west-1 to absorb load in case az1a degrades more.

raj (runtime): another observation: clients using long-lived connections saw sticky-session econnreset for some workers. We're enabling automatic reconnect backoff client hints in the proxy until health stabilizes.

cloud-support-bot: AWS update: "We've applied a control-plane patch to ENI drivers in the affected hosts; monitoring for stabilization. If issues persist, they'll perform host-level remediation."

sarah (oncall): planning: 1) continue incremental traffic shift off az1a to 60% total 2) keep prefix caching on 3) spin up extra capacity in other AZs 4) open customer comms drafted by product-ops 5) engage night oncall handoff in 30m unless resolved.

product-ops: draft OK, please include guidance: "We’re routing traffic to alternate zones and scaling capacity; you may see transient increases in latency while we stabilize. No data loss."

michael (infra): traffic shift now at 60%. Seeing improved error rate: 5xx ~2.1%, p95 ~680ms overall. az1a network metrics slowly trending down but noisy.

raj (runtime): turning on aggressive cache prefill for hot prompts to reduce cold-start tail. Command:```\nprefill-tool --model star-13B --prompts /ops/hot_prompts.json --parallel 8\n```

sarah (oncall): logging timeline + commands in incident doc. Notifying CS and status page. cc @dana (oncall-night) — will hand over if not cleared in 30m.

product-ops: posting status page update draft to #status-drafts. Recommend wording: "Service performance impacted for a subset of requests due to network instability in a single AWS AZ. We are routing traffic to alternate zones and scaling capacity; mitigations applied. Engineers are actively working with the cloud provider."

cloud-support-bot: AWS case updated: they requested host list for impacted instances; michael to provide securely.

michael (infra): provided host list to AWS support via secure portal. Also enabling additional ENI-level metrics and tracing for backfill.

sarah (oncall): current action items: (1) monitor error rate and p95 (2) keep traffic shifted until ENI jitter clears (3) prefill caches and scale extra nodes (4) prepare rollback plan to reduce cross-region traffic if customers report higher latencies.

dana (oncall-night): I'm warming up and will take handoff in 25m. If any significant regression after handoff, @dana will page infra & runtime.

sarah (oncall): final note before handoff: throttle-in ramp-down of traffic shift planned once ENI metrics stable for 10m. Leaving prefix-cache enabled for 2h post-stabilization.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-33245 status: mitigated -> partial; monitoring. Last update posted to status page.

sarah (oncall): closing slack thread for now, will reopen if noise reappears.
